visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an indoor scene showing the back of an orange and white cat sitting on a cactus-patterned mat. A person's hand, with a white gauze bandage wrapped around the wrist, reaches out and gently strokes the cat's back. The lighting is bright and even, suggesting a well-lit home environment. (2) The hand is moved in front of the cat's face, displaying the bandaged area. The cat momentarily looks towards the hand but then quickly turns its head away, seemingly indifferent. (3) The hand repeatedly attempts to gain the cat's attention by petting and then showing the wound, while the cat continues to look in the opposite direction or stare at the floor. (4) The scene shifts to the cat lying down on a pink mat with cherry blossom patterns. The hand strokes the cat's head and neck. (5) The person brings their fingers close to the cat's nose for it to sniff, then reveals the bandaged wrist again; the cat promptly turns away once more. (6) A transition occurs to a high-quality product shot of a desk calendar featuring a close-up photo of a cat yawning. (7) A pair of hands is shown holding and rotating a gold-colored commemorative coin featuring an illustration of a cat on a horse. (8) The final scene shows the orange and white cat sitting upright on a white surface, looking directly into the camera lens and meowing with its mouth wide open. (9) The background consists of a minimalist indoor setting with white walls and soft studio-style lighting.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A person whose only visible parts are their hands and forearms. One wrist is prominently wrapped in white medical gauze and tape.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The initial background is an indoor home with tiled flooring and decorative mats (cactus and cherry blossom patterns). The latter part features a clean, bright studio background with white surfaces for product showcasing.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A bright, mid-tempo acoustic guitar BGM with glockenspiel accents begins. A male voice speaks in a friendly, high-arousal tone, addressing a cat named 'Ama'. (2) A clear, synthesized 'ding' sound effect triggers as text bubbles appear visually. The speaker's pitch rises as he asks the cat for sympathy regarding his bandaged hand. (3) A sharp, high-pitched cat meow is heard, synchronized with the cat's mouth movement. (4) The music continues smoothly as the voice transitions into a professional yet energetic promotional delivery, detailing calendar and coin sets. (5) Another series of soft 'pop' UI sound effects occur during the mention of early-bird discounts and the website URL.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous, relatable interaction between a pet owner and their cat (the popular character 'Ama') to capture the audience's attention. After establishing an emotional hook through the cat's funny indifference to the owner's 'injury', it seamlessly transitions into a product showcase for the 2026 Fumeancats calendar and commemorative gold coin set, encouraging viewers to take advantage of early-bird pricing.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of products (calendar, gold coin) along with website links, pricing deadlines, and brand logo '瑪瑪商行'.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video combines high-engagement short-form pet content with commercial promotion, utilizing variety-show style text and sound effects to maintain viewer interest.
